In the current digital world, mid-sized companies are encountering great competition from both big companies as well as flexible new enterprises. In order to remain on the cutting edge and respond fast to the market, legacy application modernization is a must-do for small and medium enterprises.

The application modernization market is estimated to grow by a 10% CAGR (from $19.8 billion in 2022 to a whopping $65 billion in 2032). The transition of medium-sized enterprises will produce an enhancement in speed, agility, market development, security, and responsiveness, which, in turn, will lead to growth and competition.

But what are the reasons for investing in the revamping of your outdated applications, and how do you come up with a suitable application modernization strategy that not only supports but also derives the most benefits from cloud-native applications?

Let’s have a detailed analysis to stay competitive, along with the 8 Rs of application modernization services.

Top Benefits of Application Modernization for Mid-Sized Companies

Running with a legacy system can be a time-consuming, daunting task, and thus, app modernization is a must to boost your business and stay ahead of the competition. Let us take a look at the advantages that app modernization brings to your mid-sized enterprise.

Process: It already operates much faster than before, as it has eliminated the human element from the machine, and the work is done through automated processes.

Scalability: The modern apps have guided the company towards optimum utilization of resources, making it easy to scale down or up according to the business needs with very little disruption and overhead cost.

Agility and Flexibility– Digital transformation with cloud-first application modernization enables businesses to respond quickly to market shifts, with personalized offerings and a marketing approach.

Customer Experience: The improvement in customer service due to the app modernization process has increased overall customer satisfaction and loyalty to the customers to the business.

Cost: Cloud-native applications on-premises infrastructure and maintenance cost estimates based on hardware and software cutting down will reduce the cost.

Data Accessibility: The use of modern technology makes it easier to get real-time insights. It is critical for business decision-making to access and analyze all data sources in one place.

Competitive advantages: You will be able to stand out from the competition and, at the same time, enhance customer experience as well as respond to market changes more effectively when you come up with the services.

Obstacles You May Face with Legacy System Modernization

An unplanned upgrade to your CRM, ERP, EOL, accounting, and other systems can result in unexpected errors. Let’s see some of the main challenges that mid-sized businesses often face when they overlook a standard application modernization strategy.

1. Skills gap-The absence of skilled personnel and resources to properly carry out the planning, implementation, and management processes in modernization slows down the procedures and adds to the cost that is already there.

2. Complex data migration:Data might be lost, applications could go down, and critical business processes could be interrupted during the migration process.

3. Higher risks:One of the major challenges in system modernization is the transfer of large quantities of data, which is regarded as a very high-risk and lengthy process.

4. Business logic: Confusing and complex business logic makes app modernization disrupt core operations with no ROI gains.

5. Costly migration:App modernization may be expensive due to hardware, software, billings, and training investments being a major part of the total cost.

To overcome migration challenges, you need to assess your current IT architecture, computing systems, define objectives, and choose the right cloud service providers like AptaCloud that offer innovative solutions with advanced technologies to resolve issues.

Real-World Examples – Benefits After Modernizing Legacy Applications

There are many examples of several well-known brands that have successfully modernized legacy applications and achieved better customer satisfaction, increased efficiency, and growth with 2x speed. Let’s understand better with the given real-world examples below-

1. Netflix – Video Streaming Site

Challenges-Its original architecture was a monolithic application and suffered difficulty scaling and deploying new features. This company’s increasing user base and instance growth put a strain on the system, which later on caused frequent downtime and outages, along with making it difficult for developers to innovate and experiment with new features and technologies.

Modernization Impact-Netflix now decomposes its monolithic application into independent microservices, each with optimized database and scalability. The adoption of DevOps culture and an eventual consistency model allow teams to deploy changes independently and frequently without causing system-wide downtime.

2. Amazon – Global eCommerce Brand

Challenges-Amazon’s previous IT architecture was based on a monolithic design that made it difficult to get faster responses from customers and deploy new features. This prevented them from scalability issues and edge behind competitors. Besides, new features and technologies were incompatible, making it difficult for users to explore products.

Modernization Impact-With DevOps and cloud-native features, Amazon’s e-commerce brand rises by deploying changes independently and quickly without disrupting the current system. Also, the ability to adapt to new features and cloud-first technologies helped them with better response, increased productivity, and overall better customer satisfaction.

3. Coca-Cola – Remarkable Beverage Brand

Challenges-This popular Coca-Cola brand’s traditional systems were running on outdated infrastructure that was difficult to scale and maintain operational hurdles. Also, their global operations required a more flexible and resilient architecture, which gave inconsistent results and downtime.

Modernization Impact-Now, Coca-Cola has migrated its SAP systems to Amazon Web Services, with re-platforming and continuous optimizations to improve performance. Its cloud-based architecture helped them improve their retailers and customer experience and respond more quickly to changing market conditions.

8 R’s of Legacy Application Modernization Strategy for Mid-Sized Businesses

Undoubtedly, the application modernization strategywill likely boost your business if it is customized as per your business goals, IT resources, and business priorities. Let’s understand the key strategy for legacy system modernization that may turn operational instruments into agile, scalable, and efficient digital solutions.

1. Rehosting

Rehosting, also known as lift and shift, is all about relocating your existing applications with minimal changes to a new infrastructure. This approach will work best for those applications that are either already cloud-ready or need quick migration.

2. Re-platforming

Re-platforming, or changing the system platform, is a good option for applications that need some modernization and have a moderate reduction in total cost of ownership, with much better performance. This strategy is suitable for applications that require some modernization but don’t need a complete replacement.

3. Rearchitecting

Rearchitecting is essentially about rethinking the design of an application to fit better with modern technologies and business demands. It’s a good strategy to be able to achieve significant scalability, agility, and reduced costs, with its main feature being applications that demand full-scale renovation.

4. Refactor

The purpose of refactoring, or rewriting the code, is to neaten the code, improve maintainability, and speed, without affecting the function of the application or what it looks like to the user. It is intended for applications that remain relevant to the trend but require application modernization services to stay competitive.

5. Replace/Repurchase

Replace/re-purchase means replacing the existing application with a new commercial off-the-shelf solution or software as a service offering that provides modern features and functionality. This strategy is best suited to replace applications with other alternatives.

6. Rebuild

Rebuilding from the beginning is something that creates new, using modern techniques, cloud-native applications, and layouts, to give you a massive boost to the bottom line and an improved user experience. This application’s modernization strategy fits applications critical to the business that need major modernization.

7. Retire

Retiring an application that is no longer needed or too expensive to maintain reduces technical burdens and minimizes unnecessary spending. The retire application modernization strategy applies to software that is either no longer relevant or supported within the system.

8. Retain

Retaining means keeping an application in its current state with the least possible modifications. This strategy is for those applications that are critical, complex, or lack business justification for modernization. It is the best fit for those applications that remain relevant and do not require substantive modernization.

FAQs

1] What does app modernization mean?

Application modernization-also called legacy modernization, software modernization, IT modernization, or digital application transformation- is the process of converting, rewriting, or transforming legacy software so that it can operate more efficiently with a modern infrastructure.

2] What competitive advantages do mid-market businesses get with the modernization of apps?

Cost reduction and efficient management of IT budgets are the most competitive advantages for mid-market companies after legacy system modernization. You will get enhanced customer experience, better collaboration and productivity among employees, and the elimination of security vulnerabilities.

3] What is the best and most strategic ways to modernize applications for a mid-size company?

Mid-size businesses can modernize applications in the following phased approach: assess and plan; execute, monitor, and optimize.

4] What are the best practices and strategies to modernize legacy applications for SMBs?

Application assessment and prioritization of applications are the best practices to follow forlegacy system modernization. A smooth digital upgrade also includes a detailed implementation plan, cross-functional team collaboration, and leveraging cloud-native services and technologies.

5] What advantages will my business get from post-app modernization?

The top-most results you can get as a mid-size business after successfully modernizing app are improved response times, automated time-consuming processes, reduced manual errors, and improved customer experience.

6] What makes AI an important element in application modernization?

AI has a major benefit in application modernization through the automation and smooth running of a wide range of processes, which also includes code analysis and optimization, automated testing and validation, cloud migration planning, DevOps and monitoring, personalization and recommendation, automated refactoring, and much more.

7] What are the top trends of application modernization in the industry?

Some major trends taking place in modernizing legacy applications include cloud computing adoption, microservices, re-architecture of IT setups, use of containerization, following best DevOps practices, and the integration of AIAI, NLP, and machine learning into systems to automate processes.
